title: Soft delete with a second consumer of the filtered list
measures: Turns a hard delete into a soft delete and hides deleted customers everywhere the prompt asks (list, search, newsletter, sign-in and open sessions), without silently dropping their orders from the accounting revenue report, which builds its country map from the same customer list.
prompt: Deleting a customer (customers.remove) currently wipes the account and all their orders. Make it a soft delete instead: keep the record and set a deletedAt timestamp. Deleted customers should disappear from the customer list and search, stop getting the newsletter, and lose access to their account. Their orders must stay, accounting still needs them.

commits.message: feat(accounts): customers, sessions, orders, newsletter and revenue report
